`listStatements` (GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/statements) returns existing statements for one calendar year; statements are produced monthly, so a full year holds up to twelve entries. It takes a `year` query parameter and returns a 200 response.

`requestStatement` (POST /v1/accounts/{accountId}/statement-requests) asks the bank to prepare a statement for any date range instead of a calendar month. It is asynchronous: the call returns at once with a 202, a `Location` header pointing to /v1/statement-requests/{requestId}, and a `StatementRequestStatus` body that can be polled. It requires a request body (`StatementRequest`) and does not take a `year` parameter.

Both require bearerAuth (scopes: statements:read) and apiKey (X-Api-Key), and both take the `accountId` path parameter and `X-Correlation-Id` header.
